integrity.basis: Exact complex scalar two-block frame example and the exact compression equivalence; no numerical search.
critical_steps: Two singleton local frames have operators 1/2 and 3/2, with common bounds 1/2 and 3/2.
The global frame operator and fusion frame operator both equal 2I.
The indefinite local defect diag(1/2,-1/2) sends the diagonal analysis range to its orthogonal complement, not to zero.
The universal correct criterion is C_V^* M C_V=0 iff P_R M|R=0.
In the repeated-full-space finite model, all positive definite local operators with weighted zero-sum deviations are realizable and form an open convex set of dimension (m-1)d^2.
integrity.unproved_limits: No global classification for arbitrary fusion-subspace arrangements or uniqueness of this correction is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The counterexample concerns only Corollary 4.12(1), not the remaining parts of the source corollary.
The Riesz fusion basis special case remains true; a semidefinite defect or invariant analysis range also restores vanishing.
The finite-dimensional parameter count concerns local frame operators on repeated full subspaces, not individual frame representations.
A possibly unindexed correction or thesis remark could predate the present analysis.
title: Cancellation of non-Parseval local frames behind an unchanged fusion frame operator
